description.en: How Warren Buffett communicates with shareholders, media, and the public
description.zh: 沃伦·巴菲特如何与股东、媒体和公众沟通

description.en: Uses simple language that anyone can understand
description.zh: 使用任何人都能理解的简单语言

example.en: Explains complex financial concepts using everyday analogies
example.zh: 用日常类比解释复杂的金融概念

description.en: Openly admits mistakes and bad decisions
description.zh: 公开承认错误和糟糕的决定

buffett_quote.en: I will tell you the mistakes I make. You won't have to read about them in the papers.
buffett_quote.zh: 我会告诉你我犯的错误。你不必在报纸上读到它们。

description.zh: 使用自嘲式幽默和机智

example.en: Often jokes about his own mistakes and limitations
example.zh: 经常拿自己的错误和局限开玩笑

description.en: Speaks in a down-to-earth, Nebraska style
description.zh: 以朴实的内布拉斯加风格说话

structure: Closes with optimism about the future

buffett_quote.en: I try to write the annual letter as if I were writing it to my sisters.
buffett_quote.zh: 我试着把年度信写得就像写给我的姐妹们一样。

approach: Shares stage with Charlie Munger for decades

buffett_quote.zh: 这是资本家的伍德斯托克。

style: Stays on message about long-term value

signature_expressions.usage: Describing high-quality companies with durable advantages
Explaining the limits of one's knowledge
Emphasizing the importance of buying at a discount

philosophy.en: Share wisdom through stories and examples
philosophy.zh: 通过故事和例子分享智慧

methods: Use concrete examples from Berkshire's portfolio
